name: Cologix Santa Clara SV1 Data Center

profile.reading: This Cologix facility is part of the company Ashburn, Virginia or Silicon Valley, California footprint. Cologix own site states the company has been operational since December 2010 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, describing itself as North America leading network neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company, with 45 plus facilities across 13 North American markets serving about 2,000 customers with access to 725 plus networks and 350 plus cloud service providers. Confirmed United States markets include Ashburn, Virginia; Columbus, Ohio; Dallas, Texas; Des Moines, Iowa; Jacksonville and Lakeland, Florida; Minneapolis, Minnesota; New Jersey; and Silicon Valley, California, where the company SV1 facility was acquired from vXchnge in 2021. Cologix grew through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2010, including Navisite, The Minnesota Gateway, Canix, MetroOptic in 2019, vXchnge in 2020 to 2021, and Cyxtera in 2023, the last of which connects to the separate Cyxtera operator record elsewhere in this registry. No building specific address or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
